items.title: Gerald Wiggins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 2, 1995
items.q: The interviewee refers to himself in the third person as 'Gerry' ('why Gerry was so sleepy', 'Oh, Gerry'), indicating 'Gerry' is the interviewee himself, not another person.

ctx.x: I was going to say, how can you handle that?
Well now my history teacher moved out here, and she pulled the cover off me. She told my wife she says, “Yeah I often wondered why Gerry was so sleepy in class — I found out.”
He was a working man already. That’s great. And the atmosphere in New York at that time was pretty happening, right?
